Exam Date & Time: 07-May-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - APRIL / MAY 2025  
  SUBJECT: PHY 1071/PHY_1071 - ENGINEERING PHYSICS  
  ENGINEERING PHYSICS [PHY 1071-PHY]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                                       Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               Explain attenuation in optical fiber. Discuss the three main sources for attenuation in optical fibre.                    (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
1B)               The ratio of Einstein's coefficient (A 21/B12) is 6.2 x 10-15 for a lasing system at 300 K. Calculate the wavelength of   (4)  
  the radiation emitted by a laser. Calculate the rate of stimulated to spontaneous emission.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
1C)               The statement 'temperature of the atom can be reduced to nanokelvin using laser'. State whether the statement is          (2)  
  true or false. Justify your answer.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2A)               Derive the expression for Compton shift using laws of conservation of energy and momentum. Show at which                  (4)  
  scattering angle Compton shift is minimum.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
2B)               X-rays of wavelength       = 0.20 nm are scattered from a block of material. The scattered X-rays are observed at         (4)  
  an angle of 45° to the incident beam. Calculate the scattered X-ray wavelength and Compton shift.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2C)               In the Davisson-Germer experiment, electrons are accelerated at 52 V potential difference. Calculate the de-              (2)  
  Broglie wavelength of the fast-moving electrons which are ejected from Davisson-Germer experimental set-up.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3A)                                                                                                                                           (4)  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
3B)               The frequency of photon that causes v = 0 to v = 1 transition in the CO molecule is 6.42 x 1013 Hz. Ignore any            (4)  
  changes in the rotational energy.  
  
  A) Calculate the force constant k for this molecule.  
  B) What is the maximum classical amplitude of vibration for this molecule in the v = 0 vibrational state? Use  
  reduced mass of CO molecules as 1.14 x 10-26Kg.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"

3C)                   When an electron and a proton of the same kinetic energy encounter a potential barrier of the same height and          (2)  
  width, which one of them will tunnel through the barrier more easily? Why?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4A)                   Describe dielectric constant, susceptibility, dielectric loss, and strength.                                           (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
4B)                   An HCl molecule is excited to its second rotational energy level. If the distance between its nuclei is ro = 0.1275    (4)  
  nm, what is the angular speed(ω) of the molecule about its center of mass?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4C)                                                                                                                                                (2)  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5A)                   With a neat diagram, explain the preparation of nanomaterials by top down and bottom-up approach give an               (4)  
  example for each.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
5B)                   Distinguish between conductors, insulators and semiconductors based on band theory.                                    (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5C)                   The job of an exhaust nozzle in an aircraft is to produce thrust that helps the aircraft to maintain speed. Among  (2)  
  metal glass, shape memory alloy, and biomaterials which material will be useful in manufacturing of exhaust nozzle  
  and why?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"
